source_refs.note: Basic Rule of Probability: a main subheading of 18.2.2 Inheritance and Mathematical Probabilities, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 89-89.

blocks.text: Probability is calculated by dividing the number of times an event occurs by the total number of possible outcomes.

blocks.title: Performing and Recoding
blocks.text: Use the rules of probability and calculate the probability of getting Sixes when you roll a dice 100 times.
For example, if wrinkled pea seeds appear 1,850 times out of 7,324 seeds, the probability is 1,850 ÷ 7,324 = 0.253, which is about 1 in 4 seeds.
